title: Yunnan Lijiang & Dali 6-Day In-Depth Tour
included: All admission tickets as per itinerary

itinerary.title: Departure → Lijiang
itinerary.description: Arrive in Lijiang by air and be met by private transfer to your boutique inn in Lijiang Old Town. Stroll through Sifang Street at your leisure in the afternoon, soaking in the laid-back Naxi culture. In the evening, enjoy sunset views of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain from an old-town viewing platform. Optional dinner: try Lijiang's famous cured pork rib hotpot (at your own expense).

itinerary.title: Lijiang → Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
itinerary.description: After breakfast, travel to Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and take the large glacier cable car up to the 4,506-meter observation deck for breathtaking alpine views. Descend to Blue Moon Valley, where the crystal-clear Baishui River mirrors the snow-capped peaks — a truly ethereal landscape.

itinerary.title: Lijiang → Lashi Sea → Shuhe Ancient Town
itinerary.description: Head to Lashi Sea Wetland Park for a horseback ride and boat trip along the historic Tea Horse Road, experiencing traditional Naxi culture. In the afternoon, explore Shuhe Ancient Town — quieter and more authentic than Lijiang Old Town, perfect for a leisurely wander.

itinerary.title: Lijiang → Dali (Erhai Lake)
itinerary.description: Drive to Dali (approx. 2.5 hours), then tour the scenic Erhai Lake area. Visit Shuanglang and Xizhou Ancient Town, cycle along the famous Erhai Lake S-curve with Cangshan Mountain as your backdrop, and capture stunning lake views.

itinerary.title: Dali Old Town → Three Pagodas
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Dali Old Town — wander through Wuhua Tower and Renmin Road to experience the charm of the ancient Nanzhao Kingdom. In the afternoon, tour the Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple, an iconic architectural landmark of Dali and all of Yunnan.

itinerary.title: Dali → Return
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy free time before heading independently to Dali Airport or train station to conclude your wonderful Dali-Lijiang journey. If you need a transfer to the station, please notify your guide in advance.

title: Sichuan Jiuzhaigou & Huanglong 4-Day Best Highlights Tour
included: All admission tickets as per itinerary

itinerary.title: Departure → Chengdu → Jiuzhaigou
itinerary.description: Fly into Chengdu, where your guide will meet you and accompany you toward Jiuzhaigou. En route, pause at the Yingxiu Earthquake Memorial site. Check in to your hotel near Jiuzhaigou Park entrance in the evening.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Jiuzhaigou Tour
itinerary.description: Full-day tour of Jiuzhaigou Valley, exploring the famous Five-Color Pool, Pearl Shoal, Nuorilang Waterfall, and Five-Flower Sea by scenic shuttle. Known as a 'fairyland on earth,' Jiuzhaigou captivates with its harmonious mountain-water scenery and vivid colors.

itinerary.title: Jiuzhaigou → Huanglong
itinerary.description: Drive to Huanglong Scenic Area to admire its renowned quartet: colorful pools, snow-capped peaks, canyons, and forests. The vibrant travertine pools of Huanglong offer a completely different charm from Jiuzhaigou — a paradise for photography enthusiasts.

itinerary.title: Jiuzhaigou → Chengdu → Return
itinerary.description: After breakfast, return to Chengdu with an optional stop at the Dujiangyan irrigation system (own expense). Arrive in Chengdu in the afternoon where your guide will see you off at the airport or train station, concluding your unforgettable Jiuzhaigou adventure.

title: Guilin & Yangshuo Lijiang River 5-Day Scenic Tour
excluded: Yangshuo Ten-Mile Art Corridor bike rental

itinerary.title: Departure → Guilin
itinerary.description: Arrive in Guilin and transfer to your hotel. In the afternoon, explore the city at your leisure and visit Elephant Trunk Hill. In the evening, take a stroll along the Two Rivers and Four Lakes scenic area.

itinerary.title: Guilin → Longji Rice Terraces
itinerary.description: Travel to Longji Rice Terraces, visiting the Ping'an Zhuang Village Terraces and Jinkeng Hongyao Terraces. Tier upon tier of paddies cascade from the foothills to the mountain summit — a magnificent landscape and a must-see for photographers.

itinerary.title: Guilin → Lijiang River Cruise → Yangshuo
itinerary.description: Cruise along the best section of the Lijiang River (Yangdi to Xingping), taking in famous sights like Nine-Horse Mural Hill, the Yellow Cloth Reflexion, and the Xingping Fishing Village. Arrive in Yangshuo in the afternoon and explore West Street.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Yangshuo
itinerary.description: Optional morning activities include a Yulong River bamboo raft ride and a cycling tour along the Ten-Mile Art Corridor. In the afternoon, tour the Silver Cave limestone grotto. In the evening, attend the Impression Liu Sangejie outdoor performance (optional, at own expense).

itinerary.title: Yangshuo → Guilin → Return
itinerary.description: After breakfast, return to Guilin with an optional stop at the Shangri-La scenic area en route. In the afternoon, transfer to the airport or train station based on your departure time, wrapping up a wonderful Guilin adventure.

title: Tibet Lhasa & Nyingchi 7-Day Pilgrimage Journey
included: 6 nights in hotels (4-star in Lhasa, 3-star in Nyingchi)
excluded: Round-trip transportation (we can help book flights/trains)

itinerary.title: All Destinations → Lhasa
itinerary.description: Travel to Lhasa by train or plane (train recommended for gradual altitude acclimatization). Check in and rest to adjust to the high-altitude environment. No itinerary today — rest is the priority.

itinerary.title: Lhasa City Tour
itinerary.description: Visit the Potala Palace, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and former winter palace of the Dalai Lama. In the afternoon, explore Jokhang Temple and Barkhor Street, immersing yourself in Tibetan Buddhist culture.

itinerary.title: Lhasa → Namtso Lake
itinerary.description: Journey to Namtso Lake, one of Tibet's three sacred lakes, where brilliant blue waters are ringed by snow-capped peaks — a heavenly scene. Return to Lhasa in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Lhasa → Nyingchi
itinerary.description: Travel along National Highway 318 to Nyingchi, passing through the Mila Mountain Pass at 5,013 meters. Enjoy scenic views of the Nyang River valley en route, then check in to your hotel in Nyingchi.

itinerary.title: Nyingchi → Yarlung Tsangpo Grand Canyon
itinerary.description: Head to the Yarlung Tsangpo Grand Canyon, the world's largest canyon, for up-close views of the towering Namcha Barwa Peak (also known as the Shy Maiden Peak). Return to Nyingchi in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Nyingchi → Lhasa
itinerary.description: Visit Basum Lake, a high-altitude barrier lake and sacred Tibetan Buddhist site. In the afternoon, return to Lhasa along the same route.

itinerary.title: Lhasa → Return
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport or train station based on your departure time, concluding an unforgettable Tibet pilgrimage. We recommend saving half a day for free exploration in Lhasa to shop for Tibetan souvenirs.

title: Qinghai Lake & Chaka Salt Lake 3-Day Self-Drive Tour

itinerary.title: Xining → Qinghai Lake
itinerary.description: Depart from Xining toward Qinghai Lake, enjoying stunning highland meadow scenery along the way. Upon arrival, explore the Erlangjian scenic area. In the evening, watch the sunset over Qinghai Lake at Heima River.

itinerary.title: Qinghai Lake → Chaka Salt Lake → Gangcha
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Chaka Salt Lake — the 'Mirror of the Sky' — for stunning mirror-like reflection photos. In the afternoon, tour the surrounding Qinghai Lake area and stay overnight in Gangcha County.

itinerary.title: Gangcha → Xining
itinerary.description: Return to Xining along the West Lake Ring Road, with an optional visit to the Atomic City Memorial Hall en route. Arrive in Xining in the afternoon, concluding the tour.

title: Guizhou Huangguoshu & Xijiang Miao Village 5-Day Tour

itinerary.title: Departure → Guiyang
itinerary.description: Arrive in Guiyang and transfer to your hotel. In the afternoon, explore Jiaxiu Pavilion at your leisure and sample local snacks such as Changwang noodles and sour fish hotpot.

itinerary.title: Guiyang → Huangguoshu
itinerary.description: Travel to Huangguoshu Waterfall — Asia's largest waterfall — and explore the Tiptop Pond Waterfall and Tianxingqiao scenic areas, experiencing the full grandeur of the cascading waters.

itinerary.title: Huangguoshu → Libo
itinerary.description: Head to Libo Xiaoqikong, often called the 'Emerald of the Earth,' and visit the Seven-Arch Bridge, Laya Waterfall, and Water Forest scenic spots.

itinerary.title: Libo → Xijiang Qianhu Miao Village
itinerary.description: Visit Xijiang Qianhu Miao Village — the world's largest Miao settlement — to explore the stilted house complexes, enjoy traditional Miao song and dance performances, and feast on a traditional long-table banquet.

itinerary.title: Xijiang → Zhenyuan → Guiyang Return
itinerary.description: Travel to Zhenyuan Ancient Town to explore the historic architecture along the Wuyang River. In the afternoon, return to Guiyang for your departure transfer, concluding your Guizhou adventure.
